content:
The image shows a single mango leaf with:
- Multiple small, dark brown to black irregular lesions scattered across the leaf surface
- Lesions appear sunken or necrotic, some with defined margins
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No sooty black surface coating (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No shoot/stem dieback (rules out Die Back)
- Lesions match the classic presentation of Anthracnose: discrete dark necrotic spots on leaf tissue caused by *Colletotrichum gloeosporioides*
